title: Let the Guru’s word steady the doubt
summary: Doubt loses force when the Guru’s word is allowed to govern the mind longer than argument does. Let one trusted instruction outlast the next inner objection.
takeaway: Let the instruction you already trust outlast the next argument.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts circling, return to one line you already trust and obey it in one small act before seeking another answer.

source.shortMeaning: Peace grows as the Guru’s word is lived and doubt stops ruling the mind.
source.lifeApplication: Let one trusted line become action before reopening the whole debate.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace grows as the Guru’s word is lived and doubt stops ruling the mind.
evidence.turn: In this window, doubt is answered by walking in the Guru’s Will until peace becomes practical.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts circling, return to one line you already trust and obey it in one small act before seeking another answer.
